title: Map Configuration
description: A Mapbox-powered geospatial visualization widget for displaying location-based data on interactive maps. Use this widget for GPS tracking, asset locations, geographic heatmaps, route visualization, or any data with latitude/longitude coordinates. Supports multiple layer types including circles (points), symbols (icons), heatmaps (density), and lines (tracks/routes). Features auto-follow mode to keep markers in view, multiple map styles, and pivot-based auto-generation of layers from data columns. Ideal for fleet management, IoT device monitoring, field service tracking, and geographic data analysis.

aiSelection.dataShape: Points carrying coordinates: dataseries[].data[] entries with lon and lat, optionally alt and a numeric value, rendered as circles, icons, a density heatmap or connected lines. Positions alone are enough; value only sizes circles, weights the heatmap and labels markers. A pivot column produces one layer per distinct value.
useWhen: Position on the earth is the point — vehicle and asset locations, site maps, field service, GPS traces.
A route or track should be drawn by connecting points in order (dataseries[].type: 'line').
Density across an area should be shaded (dataseries[].type: 'heatmap').
The view should keep every current marker or track in view as data arrives (follow: true); with latestValues: 1 it follows each asset's newest position.
notFor: Coordinates that are only incidental, where the real question is a measured value over time — use widget-linechart.
Positions on a floor plan, schematic or photo rather than on the earth — use widget-overlay.
Distance, speed or dwell time presented as numbers — use widget-value or widget-table.
How long an asset stayed in each place or state — use widget-statehistory.

title.title: Title
title.description: The main heading displayed above the map. Use to describe what geographic data is being shown (e.g., 'Fleet Locations', 'Sensor Network').

subTitle.title: Subtitle
subTitle.description: Secondary text displayed below the title. Use for additional context like region, time period, or data source.

style.title: Map Style
style.description: The visual appearance of the base map: 'streets' for road-focused, 'outdoors' for terrain, 'light/dark' for minimal designs, 'satellite' for aerial imagery, 'navigation' for routing focus.

showLegend.title: Show Legend
showLegend.description: When enabled, displays a legend identifying each data layer by color and label. Useful for multi-layer maps.

follow.title: Auto Follow
follow.description: When enabled, the map pans and zooms after every data update to keep all displayed points in view. When disabled, the map fits the data once and then keeps the view the user chooses.

dataseries.title: Dataseries
dataseries.description: Array of map layers. Each layer displays geographic data points with its own visualization style (circles, symbols, heatmap, or lines).

label.title: Series Label
label.description: Display name for this map layer, shown in the legend. When pivot splits the series, each pivot value appears as '<pivot value> - <label>'.

type.title: Layer type
type.description: Visualization style: 'circle' for point markers, 'symbol' for icon markers with labels, 'heatmap' for density visualization, 'line' for connected paths/routes.

color.title: Layer Base Color
color.description: Color of this layer's circles, icons and lines. When pivot splits the series, the first pivot value (or the rows without a pivot value) gets this color, and the other values get distinct colors from a fixed palette that avoids it; each value keeps its color while others come and go. Leave empty for an automatic color. Heatmaps ignore it and use a fixed blue-to-red scale.

latestValues.title: Latest Values
latestValues.description: Limit displayed data to the N most recent points per pivot group (rows arrive oldest first). Use 1 to show only each asset's current position. Leave empty to show all data.

circleConfig.title: Circle Layer Configuration
circleConfig.description: Styling options specific to circle (point) layers.

circle-blur.title: Blur
circle-blur.description: Edge blur effect from 0 (sharp edges) to 1 (fully blurred from center). Use slight blur (0.1-0.3) for softer appearance.

circle-opacity.title: Opacity
circle-opacity.description: Circle transparency from 0 (invisible) to 1 (fully opaque). Use lower values when circles overlap to see density.

text-color.title: Text Color
text-color.description: Color of the value labels drawn on the circles (shown only when Text Size is set). Defaults to black.

text-size.title: Text Size
text-size.description: Font size in pixels of the value labels drawn on the circles. Set it to show the labels; leave it empty for none.

symbolConfig.title: Symbol Layer Configuration
symbolConfig.description: Styling options specific to symbol (icon) layers.

text-color.title: Text Color
text-color.description: Color of the value label shown below each icon. Defaults to black.

text-size.title: Text Size
text-size.description: Font size in pixels of the value label shown below each icon. Defaults to 14.

icon-image.title: Icon Name
icon-image.description: Icon drawn at each point: 'marker' for a location pin, 'car-front' or 'car-top' for vehicles. Defaults to 'car-front'. Icons are drawn in the layer color and stay visible when they overlap.

icon-size.title: Icon size
icon-size.description: Scale factor for the icon: 1 is 24 px, 2 doubles it, 0.5 halves it.

heatmapConfig.title: Heatmap Layer Configuration
heatmapConfig.description: Styling options specific to heatmap (density) layers.

heatmap-intensity.title: Intensity
heatmap-intensity.description: Heat intensity multiplier. Higher values make the heatmap appear 'hotter' with colors reaching maximum faster. Default is 1.

heatmap-opacity.title: Opacity
heatmap-opacity.description: Heatmap layer transparency from 0 (invisible) to 1 (fully opaque). Lower values let the base map show through.

heatmap-radius.title: Radius Base Size
heatmap-radius.description: Base radius in pixels of each point's heat (default 30). Points with higher values spread up to twice as far.

lineConfig.title: Track Layer Configuration
lineConfig.description: Styling options specific to line (track/route) layers.

line-width.title: Line Width
line-width.description: Thickness of the route line in pixels. Use thicker lines for emphasis or when zoomed out.

icon-image.title: Icon Name
icon-image.description: Icon drawn at the newest position of the track: 'marker' for a location pin, 'car-front' or 'car-top' for vehicles. Leave empty for no icon.

icon-size.title: Icon size
icon-size.description: Scale factor for the position icon: 1 is 24 px.

data.title: Map data
data.description: Array of geographic data points. Each point needs longitude and latitude; altitude, value and pivot are optional. Rows without valid coordinates are skipped.

lon.title: Longitude
lon.description: The east-west coordinate in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). Example: -122.4194 for San Francisco. Rows without valid coordinates, or at exactly 0/0 (a GPS receiver without a fix), are skipped.

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: The north-south coordinate in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Example: 37.7749 for San Francisco.

alt.title: Altitude
alt.description: Optional altitude in meters. Accepted, but not shown on the map.

value.title: Data point value
value.description: Optional numeric value for this location. Circles grow with it, heatmaps weight by it, and circle and symbol layers can show it as a label. Points without a value are still drawn.

pivot.title: Split Data by
pivot.description: Column value used to split data into multiple layers automatically. Each unique pivot value creates a separate map layer (e.g., pivot by 'vehicle_id' for fleet tracking).
